title: 🧑‍💼 Members (Intern Cohort)
intro: We keep a tongue-in-cheek intern cohort staffed by my two cats to ensure the lab stays humane. Their titles sound formal; their deliverables revolve around purr-driven QA, desk logistics, and morale boosts. The roster is deliberately lightweight so future "fellows" can hop in when needed.

members.name: Huangdou
members.focus: Audits every keyboard and laptop lid for thermal stability; enforces daylight resource fairness across desks.
responsibilities: Runs continuous lap-temperature QA during long reading sessions.
Conducts nap-cycle experiments on soft materials in the workspace.
Escalates incidents involving unguarded snacks with silent-but-firm stare reviews.

members.name: Xiao Ju
members.focus: Provides late-night morale support and enforces regular stretch breaks with head-bump reminders.
responsibilities: Supervises keyboard ergonomics by occupying prime typing real estate.
Leads purr-based feedback loops during sprint retros.
Maintains hallway patrols to reduce toy-related security incidents.
